cinit.title: Disable cloud-init
cinit.note: Stops cloud-init from reclaiming your network config on the next boot. Writes the disable flag, masks the four units, pins network config off.
cinit.target: Debian · Ubuntu · any systemd host with /etc/cloud

sudo.title: Install sudo
sudo.note: Installs sudo on a minimal box and puts your account in the admin group. Picks the user from the argument, then the login name, then the only regular account it finds — and refuses to guess when several exist. Elevates itself through su when sudo is not there yet, so it can be piped straight into sh.
